content.title: 11 Detached Villas, Les Pastorales, Staoueli
summary: 11 individual R+2 detached villas within the Les Pastorales residential development in Staoueli, delivered with integrated site roads, utility networks, and landscaped access routes as part of a 41-villa master plan.
The residential parcel focuses on low-rise volumetric organisation, coordinated facade works, and site infrastructure to create a coherent domestic setting.
description: The 11 villas form a specific phase of the larger 41-villa Les Pastorales master plan. Execution required a coordinated sequence of all-trades construction, facade articulation, and dedicated site roads and utility connections.

Built to a structural profile of ground floor plus 2 upper floors, each villa features integrated balconies, glass balustrades, exterior render coatings, and private access pathways. Completed in 2022.
content.authority: A residential delivery defined by precise structural execution, site-specific utility connections, and coordinated facade finishing.

faq.question: What is the scope of the Les Pastorales villas project?
faq.answer: The construction and all-trades delivery of 11 individual R+2 detached villas, executed as part of a 41-villa residential master plan in Les Pastorales, Staoueli. Completed in 2022.

faq.question: What civil and infrastructure works were included on site?
faq.answer: Dedicated site roads, water, power, and utility connections were installed as part of the works scope, alongside all-trades construction and coordinated facade finishing.

faq.question: What are the architectural characteristics of the villas?
faq.answer: Each villa is ground floor plus 2 upper floors (R+2), featuring contemporary facade articulation, glass-balustrade balconies, exterior render finishes, and integrated garage access.
